overall_decision.reason: The alias/column context passed one synthetic diagnostic but showed no value delta on 24 CoSQL validation turns. The weak lexical predicted-planner arm regressed slightly against the same direct-SQL control. No method has passed broader validation or a locked proxy gate.
overall_decision.next_repo_step: Build a stronger non-oracle planner target and score planner quality before another GPU fine-tuning run or blog claim.
